english.title: Resist / obstruct secure training centre custody officer

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: CRIMINAL JUSTICE AND PUBLIC ORDER ACT 1994

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[resisted]_
(B)_[wilfully obstructed]_

**(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a custody officer

(C)_[acting in pursuance of escort arrangements]_
(D)_[performing custodial duties at a contracted out secure training centre]_
(E)_[performing contracted out functions at a directly managed secure training centre]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13(2) of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
resisted/wilfully obstructed
a custody officer
acting as an escort/performing custodial duties
at a contracted out training centre OR
performing contracted functions at a
directly managed secure training centre

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Custody officer must be readily identifiable as such when acting in pursuance of escort arrangements - see section 13(3).
(ii) See section 15 of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994 for definitions.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
